result.title: Silicone hydrogel lens with crosslinked hydrophilic coating

canonical_claim.raw_claim_text: 1. A coated silicone hydrogel contact lens, comprising: a silicone hydrogel contact lens and a non-silicone hydrogel coating thereon, wherein the non-silicone hydrogel coating is composed of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material which comprises from about 20% to about 95% by weight of first polymer chains derived from a multi-arm polyethyleneglycol having terminal epoxide groups and from about 5% to about 80% by weight of a second polymer chains derived from at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent, wherein said at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent is selected from the group consisting of: PEG-NH 2 ; PEG-SH; PEG-COOH; H 2 N-PEG-NH 2 ; HOOC-PEG-COOH; HS-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-COOH; HOOC-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-SH: multi-arm PEG with at least one amino group; multi-arm PEG with at least one carboxyl group; multi-arm PEG with at least one thiol group; PEG dendrimers with at least one amino group; PEG dendrimers with at least one carboxyl group; PEG dendrimers with at least one thiol group; and combinations thereof, wherein the coated silicone hydrogel contact lens has at least one of the properties selected from the group consisting of: an oxygen permeability of at least about 40 barrers; an elastic modulus of about 1.5 MPa or less; an Ionoflux Diffusion Coefficient, D, of, at least about 1.5×10 −6 mm 2 /min; a water content of from about 18% to about 70% by weight when fully hydrated; or combinations thereof. || 2. The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 35% to about 90% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 10% to about 65% by weight of the second polymer chains. || 3. The coated silicone hydrogel contact lens of claim 1, wherein the crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 50% to about 85% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 15% to about 50% by weight of the second polymer chains. || 7. obviousness_result.closest_prior_art_rationale: Selected as closest because it discloses the most limitations (0/8) and is in a similar technical field (contact lens).
obviousness_result.objective_technical_problem: A contact lens that can provide a stable and consistent oxygen supply to the eye, while also addressing the issue of limited wearing time due to oxygen deprivation, and potentially improving the overall comfort and health of the eye.
distinguishing_features: A non-silicone hydrogel coating composed of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material
The non-silicone hydrogel coating is composed of a mixture of first polymer chains derived from a multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and second polymer chains derived from a hydrophilicity-enhancing agent
The hydrophilicity-enhancing agent is selected from a group consisting of PEG-NH2, H2N-PEG-NH2, HOOC-PEG-COOH, H2N-PEG-COOH, and HOOC-PEG-SH
obviousness_result.technical_effect: Improving the oxygen supply and comfort of a contact lens by providing a stable and consistent oxygen supply, addressing the issue of limited wearing time due to oxygen deprivation, and potentially improving the overall comfort and health of the eye.
obviousness_result.motivation: To address the issue of limited wearing time due to oxygen deprivation and to improve the overall comfort and health of the eye.
obviousness_result.why_explanation: The claimed invention is a combination of known materials and techniques, but the specific composition and selection of the hydrophilicity-enhancing agent are not obvious. The technical effect is also not obvious, as it requires a specific combination of materials and techniques to achieve. The motivation is to address a known problem in the field, and the claimed invention provides a plausible solution. Therefore, the reasonable expectation of success is medium.
obviousness_result.anti_hindsight_notes: The claimed invention is not an obvious combination of known materials and techniques, but it is not a highly non-obvious invention either. The specific composition and selection of the hydrophilicity-enhancing agent are not obvious, but the technical effect is plausible and the motivation is to address a known problem in the field.

final_adjudication.adjudicator_rationale: Survived 102 + 103 but only 1 GOLD patents reviewed or anti-hindsight level MEDIUM.
